inbounds.noSubscriptionsFound: No subscriptions found for this inbound
inbounds.listenDesc: IP address this inbound listens on. "0.0.0.0" accepts connections on all network interfaces. Change only if you need to restrict to a specific NIC.
inbounds.portDesc: TCP/UDP port this inbound listens on. Make sure the port is not in use and your firewall allows it.
inbounds.externalAddressDesc: When the panel runs behind Docker or a reverse proxy, enter the externally accessible address for generating subscription links and QR codes.
inbounds.externalPortDesc: When the panel runs behind Docker or a reverse proxy, enter the externally accessible port. Leave empty to use the internal port.
inbounds.protocolDesc: Proxy protocol type. VMess/VLess/Trojan are the most common. Each protocol has different characteristics and use cases.
inbounds.trafficDesc: Enable traffic statistics (upload/download) for all clients on this inbound. Disable for a slight performance gain.
inbounds.enableDesc: When disabled, this inbound stops accepting connections and all clients become unreachable.
inbounds.accountsDesc: Add client accounts for multi-user protocols. Each client can have a unique UUID/password, traffic quota, expiry time, and IP limit.
inbounds.flowDesc: XTLS Vision flow control mode. Only effective when security=reality. Significantly improves performance and stealth.
inbounds.encryptionDesc: Encryption algorithm. Default is none (TLS provides encryption at the transport layer). Only set when you need an additional encryption layer.
inbounds.decryptionDesc: Decryption method. Must match the client's encryption setting. Default is none — only set when the client uses an extra encryption layer.
inbounds.ssMethodDesc: Shadowsocks encryption method. Recommend aes-256-gcm or 2022-blake3-aes-256-gcm for best security.
inbounds.trojanPwdDesc: Client connection password for Trojan protocol authentication. Use a strong random string.
inbounds.wgSecretKeyDesc: WireGuard server private key. Keep this secret — exposure compromises encryption.
inbounds.wgPublicKeyDesc: WireGuard server public key. Clients use this with their private key to establish an encrypted tunnel.
inbounds.wgPskDesc: Pre-shared key — an extra symmetric encryption layer. Optional but recommended for stronger security.
inbounds.wgMtuDesc: WireGuard maximum transmission unit. Default 1420. Too large may cause packet loss; too small reduces efficiency.
inbounds.wgWorkersDesc: Number of WireGuard worker threads. Default equals CPU core count. Usually no need to change.
inbounds.hysteriaAuthDesc: Hysteria authentication password. Client and server must match to establish a connection.
inbounds.hysteriaCongestionDesc: Congestion control algorithm. Brutal uses a fixed rate (good for metered links); BBR auto-detects bandwidth (good for unknown links).
inbounds.hysteriaSpeedDesc: Manual upload/download bandwidth in Mbps. Only used in Brutal congestion mode.
inbounds.httpAuthDesc: HTTP proxy username and password. Leave empty for no authentication.
inbounds.socksAuthDesc: SOCKS5 proxy username and password. Leave empty for no authentication.
inbounds.allowTransparentDesc: Allow transparent proxy mode. When enabled, can proxy traffic from non-SOCKS-aware applications.
inbounds.udpDesc: Enable UDP forwarding. Required for DNS queries, QUIC, online gaming, and other UDP-dependent services.
inbounds.networkDesc: Transport layer protocol — determines how data travels between client and server. TCP is basic. WebSocket/gRPC/HTTP2 disguise traffic as regular HTTP to bypass censorship.
inbounds.TlsDesc: Encrypts the transport layer to prevent eavesdropping. Reality uses a real website's certificate for camouflage — currently the most recommended anti-detection option.
inbounds.proxyProtocolDesc: Prepends the original client IP to the connection. Only use when a reverse proxy like Nginx/HAProxy sits in front of this inbound.
inbounds.tcpHttpDesc: Disguises traffic as regular HTTP requests to bypass DPI. Set Host to a common domain and Path to a random string.
inbounds.wsDesc: Wraps traffic in WebSocket connections. More stealthy than raw TCP but adds minor overhead.
inbounds.wsPathDesc: WebSocket path. Use a random string (e.g. /randomchars) to avoid signature-based detection.
inbounds.http2PathDesc: HTTP/2 request path. Use a random path to avoid signature detection.
inbounds.wsHostDesc: WebSocket Host header. Use a common domain (e.g. www.microsoft.com) to disguise the traffic destination.
inbounds.http2HostDesc: HTTP/2 Host header. Use a common domain to disguise traffic.
inbounds.grpcDesc: Transports traffic over gRPC (HTTP/2-based RPC framework). Good performance, ideal for multiplexing scenarios.
inbounds.grpcServiceNameDesc: gRPC service name. Use a random string to avoid signature-based identification.
inbounds.grpcMultiModeDesc: When enabled, all client connections share a single gRPC channel, reducing connection overhead.
inbounds.xhttpModeDesc: "auto" picks the best mode automatically. "packet-up" is optimized for upload-heavy use. "stream" is optimized for streaming.
inbounds.xhttpPaddingDesc: Appends random bytes to data packets to disrupt traffic-length fingerprinting and improve stealth.
inbounds.xhttpNoGrpcHeaderDesc: Removes gRPC-style headers so the traffic looks more like regular HTTP.
inbounds.xhttpMaxUploadDesc: Max bytes per upload chunk. Affects upload efficiency and latency.
inbounds.xhttpMinUploadIntervalDesc: Minimum interval in ms between upload chunks. Smaller = faster uploads but easier to detect.
inbounds.xhttpPaddingObfsModeDesc: Padding obfuscation mode. Determines how padding byte counts and distribution are generated.
inbounds.xhttpUplinkMethodDesc: Uplink HTTP method. POST is most common; PUT/PATCH have similar effects.
inbounds.xhttpSessionPlacementDesc: Session ID placement. Can be placed in URL path or HTTP header.
inbounds.xhttpSequencePlacementDesc: Sequence number placement. Used together with Session Placement.
inbounds.xhttpDataPlacementDesc: Data payload placement. Can be placed in HTTP body or header.
inbounds.seedDesc: XHTTP random seed for generating obfuscation patterns. Client and server must match.
inbounds.xhttpMaxBufferedUploadDesc: Maximum number of buffered upload posts before flushing.
inbounds.xhttpStreamUpServerDesc: Stream-up server timeout in seconds for stream-up mode.
inbounds.xhttpServerMaxHeaderBytesDesc: Maximum header size in bytes the server will accept. 0 = use default.
inbounds.xhttpPaddingPlacementDesc: Where to place padding data in the HTTP message.
inbounds.xmuxDesc: Xray multiplexing extension. More flexible than classic Mux — controls multiplexing behavior per traffic type.
inbounds.kcpMtuDesc: KCP maximum transmission unit. Default 1350. Too large may cause UDP fragmentation and packet loss.
inbounds.kcpTtiDesc: Transmission time interval in milliseconds. Smaller = lower latency but worse bandwidth utilization.
inbounds.kcpSpeedDesc: KCP upload/download bandwidth cap in MB/s. Prevents KCP from consuming all available bandwidth.
inbounds.kcpCwndDesc: Congestion window multiplier. Controls send speed — higher is faster but more prone to packet loss.
inbounds.kcpMaxSendDesc: KCP maximum sending window. Controls the maximum number of packets sent simultaneously.
inbounds.grpcAuthorityDesc: gRPC Authority header. Optional — customizes the HTTP/2 :authority pseudo-header.
inbounds.heartbeatDesc: Heartbeat interval in seconds. Sends periodic keep-alive packets to prevent NAT timeout disconnections.
inbounds.hysteriaVersionDesc: Hysteria protocol version. Currently must be 2.
inbounds.hysteriaUdpIdleTimeoutDesc: Idle timeout in seconds for a single QUIC native UDP connection.
inbounds.sniffingDesc: Auto-detects the real protocol inside traffic (HTTP/TLS/QUIC etc.) and routes accordingly. Enables smart traffic splitting.
inbounds.sniffOverrideDesc: Allows sniffing results to override the original destination address. Takes effect when detected target differs from the request.
inbounds.sniffMetadataDesc: Records HTTP Host, TLS SNI, and other metadata from traffic for use in routing rules.
inbounds.sniffingRouteOnlyDesc: Only use sniffing results for routing decisions, do not rewrite the destination address.
inbounds.sniffingIpsExcludedDesc: Comma-separated list of IPs/CIDRs to exclude from sniffing. Traffic to these IPs will not be analyzed.
inbounds.sniffingDomainsExcludedDesc: Comma-separated list of domains to exclude from sniffing. Traffic to these domains will not be analyzed.
inbounds.tlsSecurityDesc: Standard TLS encryption. Requires certificate and key files. Suitable when you have your own domain.
inbounds.tlsCipherSuitesDesc: Custom TLS cipher suite list. Leave empty to use default ciphers. Comma or colon separated.
inbounds.tlsMinVersionDesc: Minimum TLS protocol version to accept.
inbounds.tlsMaxVersionDesc: Maximum TLS protocol version to support.
inbounds.tlsRejectUnknownSniDesc: Reject connections when the SNI doesn't match any configured certificate. Provides stronger security.
inbounds.tlsDisableSystemRootDesc: Do not use the operating system's root CA certificates for verification.
inbounds.tlsSessionResumptionDesc: Enable TLS session resumption to reduce handshake overhead for returning clients.
inbounds.tlsOneTimeLoadingDesc: Load certificates into memory once at startup rather than on each connection.
inbounds.echKeyDesc: Encrypted Client Hello key. Prevents TLS SNI from being inspected by intermediate devices. Requires server support.
inbounds.realityDesc: XTLS enhanced encryption. Uses a real website's certificate for camouflage — no domain ownership needed. Currently the most recommended option.
inbounds.realityPubKeyDesc: Generated by Xray "x25519" command. Clients must use the corresponding private key.
inbounds.realityShortIdDesc: Short ID attached to the TLS handshake to identify clients. Optional — leave empty to accept all connections.
inbounds.realitySpiderXDesc: Enhances Reality's anti-probing capabilities. Recommended to enable.
inbounds.realityMldsa65Desc: Uses ML-DSA-65 post-quantum signature algorithm to resist quantum computing attacks. Adds handshake overhead.
inbounds.realityShowDesc: Show the Reality configuration details instead of hiding them.
inbounds.realityXverDesc: XTLS Vision protocol version for Reality.
inbounds.realityMaxTimeDiffDesc: Maximum allowed time difference in ms between client and server clocks.
inbounds.realityMldsa65SeedDesc: Seed value for ML-DSA-65 private key derivation.
inbounds.sniDesc: Server Name Indication — the target hostname sent during TLS handshake. Used to disguise the traffic destination.
inbounds.utlsDesc: Simulates mainstream browser TLS handshake fingerprints. Prevents identification as a Go/Xray client. "chrome" or "randomized" recommended.
inbounds.alpnDesc: Application-Layer Protocol Negotiation. h2=HTTP/2, http/1.1=plain HTTP.
inbounds.echDesc: Encrypted Client Hello. Prevents TLS SNI from being detected by intermediate devices. Requires server support.
inbounds.verifyPeerNameDesc: Verifies the server certificate domain to prevent man-in-the-middle attacks. Make sure the certificate domain is correct.
inbounds.pinnedSha256Desc: Certificate pinning. Only accepts certificates with a specific SHA256 fingerprint — higher security but needs updating when certificates change.
inbounds.pubKeyDesc: TLS public key file path (starting with '/').
inbounds.keyPathDesc: TLS private key file path (starting with '/'). Keep this secure.
inbounds.sockoptDesc: Low-level network parameter tuning (TCP congestion control, connection marking, interface binding, etc.). Most users should leave these unchanged.
inbounds.sockoptDialerProxyDesc: Routes all connections from this inbound through a specified outbound proxy. Used for chained proxy scenarios.
inbounds.sockoptTfoDesc: TCP Fast Open — sends data during the handshake phase, reducing connection latency by about 1 RTT. Requires server support.
inbounds.sockoptMptcpDesc: Multipath TCP — allows simultaneous data transfer over multiple network interfaces (e.g. WiFi + cellular). Requires OS support.
inbounds.sockoptPenetrateDesc: Force-penetrate — attempts to establish connections even when the destination appears unreachable. For special network environments.
inbounds.sockoptFwmarkDesc: Linux firewall mark (SO_MARK). Tags sockets for use with iptables/policy routing for traffic steering.
inbounds.sockoptInterfaceDesc: Binds outbound traffic to a specific network interface. For multi-NIC servers, forces traffic through a particular interface (e.g. eth0).
inbounds.sockoptTcpCongestionDesc: TCP congestion control algorithm. "bbr" recommended for low latency + high throughput; "cubic" is the Linux default.
inbounds.sockoptTcpWindowDesc: TCP window scaling factor. Increase for better throughput on high-bandwidth, high-latency links.
inbounds.sockoptTcpMaxSegDesc: TCP Maximum Segment Size (MSS). Limits the payload per TCP packet. Usually leave unchanged unless you have MTU issues.
inbounds.sockoptTproxyDesc: Transparent proxy mode. On Linux, works with iptables TPROXY to proxy non-local traffic.
inbounds.sockoptRouteMarkDesc: Linux routing mark (SO_MARK). Tags sockets for iptables/policy routing to steer traffic.
inbounds.sockoptKeepAliveIntervalDesc: TCP keep-alive probe interval in seconds. Periodically checks if connections are alive to prevent dead connections from consuming resources.
inbounds.sockoptKeepAliveIdleDesc: TCP keep-alive idle time in seconds before probes begin.
inbounds.sockoptUserTimeoutDesc: TCP user timeout in ms. Maximum time data may remain unacknowledged before the connection is closed.
inbounds.sockoptTcpWindowClampDesc: TCP window clamp. Caps the advertised TCP receive window size.
inbounds.sockoptV6OnlyDesc: Only use IPv6 for outbound connections from this inbound.
inbounds.sockoptDomainStrategyDesc: Address resolution strategy. "asIs" keeps original; "preferIPv4" favors IPv4; "preferIPv6" favors IPv6.
inbounds.sockoptTcpNoDelayDesc: Disable Nagle's algorithm. Sacrifices some bandwidth efficiency for lower latency. Recommended for latency-sensitive applications.
inbounds.sockoptTrustedXFFDesc: Trusted X-Forwarded-For header values. Only the listed header values will be trusted for client IP detection.
inbounds.tlsUsageOptionDesc: Certificate usage option. "encipherment" = normal TLS server; "issuance" = this cert can issue further certs; "ocsp" = only used for OCSP stapling.
inbounds.buildChainDesc: When enabled, builds a certificate chain from intermediate CAs rather than using a single leaf certificate.
inbounds.echConfigDesc: Encrypted Client Hello configuration list. Comma-separated list of base64-encoded ECH configs.
inbounds.externalProxyDesc: Route all connections from this inbound through an external outbound proxy. Used for chained-proxy and nested-proxy scenarios.
inbounds.xhttpNoSseHeaderDesc: Remove Server-Sent Events headers from responses. Makes the HTTP stream look more like a regular connection.
inbounds.xhttpPaddingMethodDesc: How padding bytes are generated. "repeat-x" repeats the same byte; "tokenish" produces pseudo-random tokens.
inbounds.xhttpSessionKeyDesc: Custom key name for the session ID when using a non-path placement.
inbounds.xhttpSequenceKeyDesc: Custom key name for the sequence number when using a non-path placement.
inbounds.xhttpUplinkDataKeyDesc: Custom key name for the uplink data payload when using a non-body placement.
inbounds.masqueradeDesc: When Xray receives an HTTP request at the proxy port, masquerade returns a normal-looking response to hide the proxy from active scanners.
inbounds.masqueradeTypeDesc: Masquerade type. "proxy" forwards to a backend URL; "file" serves static files; "string" returns a fixed response.
inbounds.masqueradeUrlDesc: Backend URL to proxy to when masquerade type is "proxy".
inbounds.masqueradeRewriteHostDesc: Rewrite the Host header to match the proxy target URL.
inbounds.masqueradeInsecureDesc: Skip TLS certificate verification for the proxy target. Only for testing.
inbounds.masqueradeDirDesc: Directory to serve static files from when masquerade type is "file".
inbounds.masqueradeContentDesc: Fixed response content when masquerade type is "string".
inbounds.masqueradeStatusCodeDesc: HTTP status code returned with the masquerade response.
inbounds.masqueradeHeadersDesc: Custom HTTP headers added to the masquerade response.

subscription.title: Informações da assinatura
subscription.subFragmentHelp: Split TLS hello packets into smaller fragments to bypass DPI detection. Adds slight connection delay but makes traffic harder to identify.
subscription.subNoisesHelp: Inject random noise packets into traffic to confuse pattern analysis. Consumes ~1-5% extra bandwidth but significantly improves stealth.
subscription.subMuxHelp: Combine multiple connections into a single TCP stream, reducing handshake overhead. Great for browsing but not ideal for large downloads or streaming.
subscription.subDirectHelp: Route specific domains/IPs directly without going through proxy. Enables split-tunneling — proxy what needs it, direct-connect the rest.
